text.tspan: 03 · Decision: static allowed prefixes on the DX gateway (A)
Connect-learned /32s stay inside AWS: only the allowed-prefixes list reaches on-prem.
That's enough, because 02 already made the /24 the only anycast route on-prem needs from AWS.
Not chosen: B TGW Connect over DX (two BGP layers) · C private IP VPN over DX · D private VIF + VGW only
